var config = Globals.gw_config()
	seed(int(config.seed))
	Upgrades.populate_ups()
	Globals.gw_event("attempt_start", config)

world = int(config.world)
	type = int(config.kind)
	level_ind = int(config.arena)
	rounds_left = 3 if type == Globals.Level.FIGHT else 1
	$BG / TutorialIcons.visible = false
	get_node("/root/Main/Top/WorldUI").player_ind = 0 if config.choice else level_ind
	Signals.emit_signal("world_changed", world)
	if config.choice:
		player.drop_in(1.0)
		Signals.emit_signal("wipe_off", Vector2(320, 240) / 2, 0)
		spawn_portal()
	else:
		load_level()
	return

var player_text = Upgrades.get_player_up_text(player_up)
	var enemy_text = Upgrades.get_enemy_up_text(enemy_up)
